interest: Shows Japan's early-1930s rice overproduction crisis shifting to a 1939 wartime shortage, amid Seiyukai Party politics.
overview: Docket (1930-39) on Japanese rice: price-stabilization efforts after early-1930s surpluses, the Rice Law debate, Seiyukai politics, ending production incentives, and a 1939 report on the emerging wartime rice crisis.

subfiles.about: A Department of State docket sheet recording incoming diplomatic reports, cross-references, and military attaché dispatches concerning rice production, price regulation, and agricultural policy in Japan from 1930 to 1939.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1930-39) on Japanese rice: falling prices, the Rice Investigation Commission, Seiyukai agitation, ending production incentives, and a 1939 report on the wartime rice crisis.
